import sys,itertools,time,json
sys.path[:0]=['.git/research-python','scripts']
from experiment_clift109 import SOURCE,PARENTS
# Keep parallel edge identities; fix first shift > second for equal parents.
paths=[[((),())]]
for i,(p,q) in enumerate(PARENTS,1):
    paths.append([(edges+(2*(i-1)+j,),vertices+(parent,)) for j,parent in enumerate((p,q)) for edges,vertices in paths[parent]])
allpaths=paths[-1]
survivors=[]
for edges,vertices in allpaths:
    if not {0,1,2}.issubset(vertices):continue
    if any(PARENTS[e//2][0]==PARENTS[e//2][1] and e%2 for e in edges):continue
    active=set(vertices)
    reduced=[tuple(e for e in es if PARENTS[e//2][e%2] in active) for es,_ in allpaths]
    if len(set(reduced))!=109:continue
    survivors.append((edges,vertices))
print('survivors',len(survivors),[[SOURCE[v] for v in vs]+[109] for es,vs in survivors],flush=True)
import z3
caps=[z3.Int('c'+str(i)) for i in range(11)]
labels=[z3.Int('e'+str(i)) for i in range(22)]
results=[]
for num,(edges,vertices) in enumerate(survivors):
    t=time.perf_counter();s=z3.Solver();s.set(timeout=10000,random_seed=0)
    for c in caps:s.add(c>=0,c<=108)
    s.add(z3.Sum(caps)==108)
    for e,x in enumerate(labels):
        p=PARENTS[e//2][e%2];s.add(x>=0,x<=caps[p])
    for i,(p,q) in enumerate(PARENTS):
        if p==q:s.add(labels[2*i]>labels[2*i+1])
    for i in range(11):
        if i not in vertices:s.add(caps[i]==0)
    for e in edges:s.add(labels[e]==caps[PARENTS[e//2][e%2]])
    sums=[z3.Sum([labels[e] for e in es]) for es,vs in allpaths]
    for v in sums:s.add(v>=0,v<=108)
    # Finite 109-bit shifts have no overflow: every partial root path
    # extends to the terminal and is bounded by sum caps=108.
    bases=[z3.BitVecVal(1,109)]
    for i,(p,q) in enumerate(PARENTS):
        a,b=labels[2*i:2*i+2]
        x=bases[p]<<z3.Int2BV(a,109);y=bases[q]<<z3.Int2BV(b,109)
        s.add(x&y==0)
        v=z3.BitVec('v'+str(i+1),109);s.add(v==x|y);bases.append(v)
    s.add(bases[-1]==(1<<109)-1)
    s.add(z3.Sum(sums)==108*109//2)
    result=s.check()
    row={'path':[SOURCE[v] for v in vertices]+[109],'status':str(result),'runtime':time.perf_counter()-t}
    if result==z3.unknown:row['reason']=s.reason_unknown()
    if result==z3.sat:row['labels']=[s.model().eval(x).as_long() for x in labels]
    results.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
open('.git/research/path-bv-results.json','w').write(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

import sys,time,json
sys.path[:0]=['.git/research-python','scripts']
import z3
from experiment_clift109 import SOURCE,PARENTS
s=z3.Optimize();s.set(timeout=30000)
t=[z3.Int('t'+str(i)) for i in range(12)]
c=[z3.Int('c'+str(i)) for i in range(12)]
r=[z3.Bool('r'+str(i)) for i in range(11)]
for i in range(12):s.add(t[i]>=0,c[i]>=0)
s.add(t[0]==0,t[-1]==0,c[-1]==0)
for i,(p,q) in enumerate(PARENTS,1):
 a=t[i]+(z3.If(r[i-1],0,SOURCE[q]) if p!=q else SOURCE[q])-t[p]
 b=t[i]+(z3.If(r[i-1],SOURCE[p],0) if p!=q else 0)-t[q]
 s.add(a>=0,b>=0,a<=c[p],b<=c[q])
h=s.minimize(z3.Sum(c));start=time.perf_counter();res=s.check()
print(res,s.reason_unknown(),time.perf_counter()-start,flush=True)
if res==z3.sat:
 print('bounds',h.lower(),h.upper());print('t',[s.model().eval(v) for v in t]);print('c',[s.model().eval(v) for v in c]);print('r',[s.model().eval(v) for v in r])
